rows.note: Use this for a bomb, device, or object physically blowing apart.

example.english: A gas cylinder can suddenly explode, shaking the whole kitchen.
example.traditional: 個氣樽突然爆炸，成間廚房都震晒。
example.jyutping: go3 hei3 zeon1 dat6 jin4 baau3 zaa3 seng4 gaan1 cyu4 fong2 dou1 zan3 saai3

rows.note: Use this when someone suddenly becomes angry or loses their temper.

example.english: They explode whenever they hear someone say they are late.
example.traditional: 佢一聽到人哋話佢遲到就發火。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 jan4 dei6 waa6 keoi5 ci4 dou3 zau6 faat3 fo2

rows.note: Use this when a quantity or population increases suddenly and dramatically.

example.english: After the summer holidays, rents in this area suddenly explode.
example.traditional: 過咗暑假之後，呢區嘅租金突然暴增。
example.jyutping: gwo3 zo2 syu2 gaa3 zi1 hau6 ne1 keoi1 ge3 zou1 gam1 dat6 jin4 bou6 zang1
